_comment: Pinned upstreams for the Theettam peridot kernel. scripts/ci/check-upstreams.py compares these against the real upstreams and reports drift. Driver/SUSFS 'current' values are READ FROM scripts/ci/pins.env at check time (the single source the builds use); only 'ack' and 'guidixx' are pinned here, as the merge state of the tree. Bumping a pin never rebuilds anything by itself: update pins.env, build, boot-test, then release.

ack.name: Android Common Kernel (android14-6.1-lts)
ack.note: A new LTS tag needs a real 3-way merge with hand-resolved conflicts. Never auto-merge to a release.

guidixx.name: GuidixX/kernel_xiaomi_sm8635 (16.2) — device base
guidixx.note: The device base this fork is built on; 'current' is the 16.2 commit merged into the kernel branch. New commits here are peridot hardware fixes (charging, display, camera) and boot-safety reverts. Merge them (git merge), never cherry-pick: the revert set is why this kernel boots. GuidixX also has a '17' branch (Android 17) that reverts several out-of-tree patches; see docs/BOOT-NOTES.md.

susfs.name: susfs4ksu (gki-android14-6.1)
susfs.note: v2.3.0: zygote_next umount-inheritance mitigation, open_redirect hook moved to path_openat()/do_tmpfile()/do_o_path() for correct SRCU scope, a sleepable static_key WARN fix. The hand-port grafts susfs's CMD dispatch into the driver's reboot kprobe; a susfs bump can move the anchors, so scripts/susfs/integrate*.sh may need work.

kernelpatch.name: KernelPatch (bmax121, APatch flavor)
kernelpatch.note: kptools/kpimg are also sha256-pinned in scripts/ci/pins.env (KPTOOLS_SHA256/KPIMG_SHA256) — a version bump here needs both the version AND both checksums updated together.
